description: Test suite for login functionality in a Django REST Framework backend, including setup, login success/failure tests, and URL variant coverage.

classes.name: LoginSmokeTests
classes.description: Test class for smoke testing login endpoints with various URL variants and input scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Creates a test user and registers it via API before running tests.

methods.name: _expect_login_ok
methods.description: Helper method to assert successful login returns tokens.

methods.name: _expect_login_fail
methods.description: Helper method to assert failed login returns error details.

methods.name: test_login_success_username_with_trailing_slash
methods.description: Tests login with username via URL ending with slash.

methods.name: test_login_success_identifier_email_with_trailing_slash
methods.description: Tests login with email identifier via URL ending with slash.

methods.name: test_login_success_identifier_email_without_trailing_slash
methods.description: Tests login with email identifier via URL without slash.

methods.name: test_login_success_root_alias_with_and_without_slash
methods.description: Tests login with username and email via root alias URLs with and without slash.

methods.name: test_login_failure_wrong_password
methods.description: Tests login failure with incorrect password.

methods.name: test_login_missing_fields_return_field_errors
methods.description: Tests API response when login payload is empty, expecting field error messages.
